decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records the selected SK6812MINI-E model, which is the only source detail necessary for this power-and-logic Requirement; the manufacturer, package, and physical dimensions do not change its current power or level-shifting rules.
The charge-status Requirement remains valid as an SK6812 addressable LED chain; the exact LED package and supplier entry do not change its indicator behavior, GPIO, or connector requirements.
This task-local package concerns power-board production files and specified power-board BOM entries, not the LED-board component selection.
The selected addressable LED model does not alter the battery connector, pinout, placement, voltage range, or AXP2101 destination.
Selecting the exact LED component does not change the main-board connector destinations, connector counts, or pin-count scope.
The source identifies an LED part but provides no change to monitored rails, monitor IC, current coverage, or channel allocation.
The LED model and package selection does not change the power board's eight-layer stack.
The LED-board component dimensions do not necessarily change the separate power board's enclosure fit, mounting holes, shape, or connector arrangement.
The exact LED entry does not affect the sensor board's input connectors, sensor output connectors, pinouts, or connector count.
The LED component selection does not change the AXP2101 VMID-to-VSYS topology or VSYS net labeling.

The source identifies the exact LED part but does not establish a new boost voltage, load allocation, output-current requirement, or enable-control rule; the existing 5V LED load state remains unchanged.
The exact LED manufacturer, part number, and package do not change any ESP32 GPIO assignment.
